title: Figure 3: ZPE resonant dielectric spheres electrical power generation (patent drawing)
description: Two patent-style line drawings with reference numerals: left, two dielectric spheres beside a receiving loop with wavy lines representing incident radiation, connected to a capacitor and transformer circuit; right, two spheres enclosed in a larger circle connected to a similar circuit with a "VAC" output. Caption: "Figure 3. ZPE Resonant Dielectric Spheres Electrical Power Generation (Reference 12)." Text below discusses the receiving structures and an Air Force Research Laboratory computer model study.
